## Download

**Inlet-VERSION.pkg**: one installer for every Mac, Apple silicon and Intel alike. Needs macOS 13 Ventura or later.

## Install

1. Open the `.pkg` and follow the steps: **Continue**, **Agree**, **Install**, then enter your Mac password.
2. Inlet opens by itself when it's done. Look for its icon in the menu bar.
3. When asked, allow Inlet to access your Downloads folder.

**The first time, macOS may say it can't verify the installer.** Inlet is free and not signed with a paid Apple certificate. **Right-click** the `.pkg` → **Open** → **Open**. No Open button? Try once, then go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** → **Open Anyway**.

**Updating:** run the new installer. It asks you to quit Inlet first. Your settings, rules and history are kept.

Prefer to build it yourself? See the [README](https://github.com/Tech-Reign-Era-Services/inlet#build-it-yourself).
